AblationConfig.description:
Flags controlling ablation modes used by the benchmark.

Attributes:
    subgroup_protocol: Whether to apply the full two-stage FDR subgroup
        protocol (``full``) or the naive single-pass ranking ablation
        (``naive``).
AblationConfig.title: AblationConfig

Algorithm.description:
Supported training algorithms.

Values are the stable string identifiers used in ``ModelSpec.algorithm``
and in every artifact that references a trained model.
Algorithm.title: Algorithm

AnalysisConfig.description:
Top-level configuration for a single ModelRoot analysis run.

This is the primary user-facing input object.  It must be fully
specified before an analysis can start.

Attributes:
    data_path: Path to the primary CSV dataset.
    target: Name of the target column.
    positive_class: Value in ``target`` that represents the positive class.
    split: How the dataset is split into train / holdout sets.
    current_path: Optional path to a third "current" dataset collected
        after deployment (used by H5 — distribution shift).
    model_spec: Algorithm and hyper-parameters to train.
    primary_metric: Performance metric used as the primary signal.
    metadata: Optional contextual hints.
    seed: Master random seed.  Must be ≥ 0.
    budget_s: Wall-clock budget in seconds for the experiment phase.
        Must be > 0.
    run_experiments: When ``False`` the engine only runs triggers
        (detector-only ablation mode, never shown to end users).
    rules_profile: Decision-rule strictness profile.
    ablation: Fine-grained ablation flags.
    explain: Whether to generate natural-language explanations.
AnalysisConfig.title: AnalysisConfig

AssessmentResult.description:
Verdict on whether the user's model is underperforming.

Attributes:
    baseline_metrics: Metrics for the user's model on train / holdout.
    dummy_metrics: Metrics for the majority-class dummy baseline.
    reference: Best reference-panel model result.
    headroom: Gap between reference and baseline on the primary metric.
    train_holdout_gap: ``train_score - holdout_score`` on the primary metric.
    current_drop: ``holdout_score - current_score`` if a labeled current
        dataset was supplied, otherwise ``None``.
    underperforming: Whether the engine concluded the model underperforms.
    reasons: List of human-readable reasons for the verdict.
    headline: One-line summary string shown to the user.
AssessmentResult.title: AssessmentResult

Decision.description:
Record of which decision rule was applied and which criteria were met.

Attributes:
    rule_id: Identifier of the versioned decision rule.
    rule_text: Human-readable description of the rule.
    rules_profile: Which rules profile was active when the decision was made.
    criteria_met: Map from criterion identifier to whether it was satisfied.
Decision.title: Decision

EffectResult.description:
Summary of the primary measured effect for a hypothesis.

Attributes:
    metric: Name of the metric.
    baseline: Baseline model metric value.
    intervention: Intervention model metric value.
    delta: ``intervention - baseline``.
    ci_low: Lower bound of the paired bootstrap CI on delta.
    ci_high: Upper bound of the paired bootstrap CI on delta.
    n: Evaluation-set size.

Raises:
    ValueError: If ``ci_low > ci_high``.
EffectResult.title: EffectResult

Evidence.description:
A single, atomic measured fact produced during an analysis.

Evidence items are the only things explanations may cite.  Each item
carries a stable ``id`` computed from its content (not from position).

Attributes:
    id: Stable identifier: ``"ev_"`` followed by 8 hex characters derived
        from a hash of ``(name, value, method, experiment_id)``.
    kind: Whether this is a passive diagnostic measurement or the result
        of a paired experiment.
    name: Human-readable name for the measured quantity.
    value: Numeric value of the measurement.
    ci_low: Lower bound of the bootstrap confidence interval.
    ci_high: Upper bound of the bootstrap confidence interval.
    n: Number of samples underlying the measurement.
    method: Name of the statistical method or computation used.
    hint: Short, template-friendly description of what this evidence means.
    experiment_id: ``ExperimentSpec.id`` if this evidence originated from
        an experiment; ``None`` for diagnostic evidence.

Raises:
    ValueError: If ``id`` is empty, or ``ci_low > ci_high`` when both are
        supplied.
Evidence.title: Evidence

EvidenceKind.description: Whether an evidence item comes from a passive diagnostic or a paired experiment.
EvidenceKind.title: EvidenceKind

ExperimentResult.description:
Result of a completed (or attempted) experiment.

Attributes:
    spec_id: References ``ExperimentSpec.id``.
    status: Terminal state of the experiment run.
    baseline_metric: Baseline model metric value on the evaluation set.
    intervention_metric: Intervention model metric value.
    delta: ``intervention_metric - baseline_metric``.
    ci_low: Lower bound of the paired bootstrap CI on delta.
    ci_high: Upper bound of the paired bootstrap CI on delta.
    n_eval: Number of evaluation-set samples.
    n_valid_boot: Number of valid bootstrap resamples (may be < n_boot
        if some resamples contained only one class).
    repeat_deltas: Delta values from repeated-subsample runs.
    consistency: Fraction of repeats with delta > 0.
    nb: Nadeau-Bengio corrected test output, if repeats were run.
    runtime_s: Wall-clock time in seconds.
    notes: Free-text notes recorded during the run.
    error: Error message if ``status`` is ``error``.

Raises:
    ValueError: If ``ci_low > ci_high``.
ExperimentResult.title: ExperimentResult

ExperimentStatus.description: Terminal state of an individual experiment run.
ExperimentStatus.title: ExperimentStatus

ExplanationOutput.description:
Natural-language explanation generated for a hypothesis result.

Attributes:
    source: How the explanation was produced — ``"template"`` for the
        deterministic template path, ``"llm"`` for the validated LLM path.
    text: The explanation text.
    provenance: Optional provenance string (e.g. model/prompt version)
        when ``source`` is ``"llm"``.
ExplanationOutput.title: ExplanationOutput

HypothesisResult.description:
Complete verdict for one hypothesis (or sub-hypothesis).

Attributes:
    id: Non-empty unique identifier for this result.
    type: Which of the five hypothesis types this result belongs to.
    subtype: Sub-claim within the hypothesis type, or ``None``.
        Allowed values depend on ``type`` — see the master plan §3.2.
    status: Verdict assigned by the rule engine.
    evidence_strength: Weighted fraction of satisfied decision criteria
        in [0, 1].  For ranking only; not a calibrated probability.
    severity: Estimated impact magnitude (only set when ``status`` is
        ``supported`` or ``weakly_supported``).
    priority_rank: Position in the overall ranking of hypotheses.
    trigger: Outcome of the trigger check.
    diagnostic_evidence_ids: IDs of ``Evidence`` items from diagnostics.
    experiment_ids: IDs of ``ExperimentSpec`` items that were run.
    effect: Summary of the primary measured effect, if available.
    decision: The rule and criteria that produced ``status``.
    confounders_checked: List of confounder names that were assessed.
    caveats: Free-text caveats about this verdict.
    recommended_actions: Suggested next steps for the user.
    explanation: Natural-language explanation, if ``explain=True``.

Raises:
    ValueError: If ``id`` is empty, ``evidence_strength`` is outside
        [0, 1], or ``subtype`` is invalid for ``type``.
HypothesisResult.title: HypothesisResult

Metadata.description:
Optional contextual hints about the dataset and task.

Attributes:
    expected_score: The user's prior expectation of model performance on
        the primary metric.  Used by the assessor to identify
        underperformance.
    unavailable_at_inference: Column names that exist in training data
        but are *not* available at inference time (potential leakage).
    id_columns: Columns that are row identifiers (excluded from features).
    sensitive_columns: Columns corresponding to protected attributes
        (used by the subgroup hypothesis).
Metadata.title: Metadata

MetricResult.description:
A scalar metric measurement on a single data split.

Attributes:
    name: Metric identifier (e.g. ``"macro_f1"``).
    value: Measured value, typically in [0, 1] for classification metrics.
    split: Data split the metric was computed on.
    n: Number of samples used for this measurement.
    ci_low: Lower bound of the bootstrap confidence interval.
    ci_high: Upper bound of the bootstrap confidence interval.

Raises:
    ValueError: If ``ci_low > ci_high`` when both bounds are supplied.
MetricResult.title: MetricResult

ModelSpec.description:
Specification of the algorithm and hyper-parameters ModelRoot will train.

Attributes:
    algorithm: Which algorithm to use.
    params: Algorithm hyper-parameters.  Values must be JSON scalars
        (int, float, str, bool, or null).  Complex types are rejected.
ModelSpec.title: ModelSpec

NBResult.description:
Output of the Nadeau-Bengio corrected resampled t-test.

Attributes:
    mean: Mean delta across repeated subsamples.
    se: Corrected standard error.
    t: t-statistic.
    df: Degrees of freedom (J - 1 where J = number of repeats).
    p: Two-sided p-value.
    ci_low: Lower bound of the corrected confidence interval.
    ci_high: Upper bound of the corrected confidence interval.

Raises:
    ValueError: If ``ci_low > ci_high``.
NBResult.title: NBResult

PrimaryMetric.description: Optimisation / evaluation metric used as the primary performance signal.
PrimaryMetric.title: PrimaryMetric

ReferenceResult.description:
Performance of the reference panel model on the holdout set.

Attributes:
    algorithm: Which algorithm was used for the reference model.
    metrics: Metrics achieved by the reference model.
ReferenceResult.title: ReferenceResult

RulesProfile.description:
Decision-rule strictness profile.

``full`` applies the complete multi-criteria protocol.
``naive`` is an ablation that uses only point-estimate Δ ≥ δ_min.
RulesProfile.title: RulesProfile

Severity.description: Estimated impact magnitude of a supported or weakly-supported hypothesis.
Severity.title: Severity

SplitConfig.description:
How the dataset is divided into training and test sets.

Attributes:
    mode: Split strategy.
    test_size: Fraction of rows reserved for the holdout set when
        ``mode`` is ``single_file``.  Must be in (0, 1).
    split_column: Column name whose values are ``"train"`` / ``"test"``
        (required when ``mode`` is ``split_column``).
    test_path: Path to a separate test-set file
        (required when ``mode`` is ``test_file``).
SplitConfig.title: SplitConfig

SplitMode.description: How the train/test split is supplied by the user.
SplitMode.title: SplitMode

Status.description: Verdict assigned to a hypothesis after evaluating its evidence.
Status.title: Status

TriggerResult.description:
Outcome of the cheap diagnostic trigger check for a hypothesis.

Attributes:
    fired: Whether the trigger fired (i.e. experiments should be run).
    rule_id: Identifier of the trigger rule that was evaluated.
    values: Measured diagnostic quantities used by the trigger decision.
TriggerResult.title: TriggerResult

description:
Complete output of one ModelRoot analysis run.

This is the single top-level artifact.  It carries ``schema_version``
for forward-compatibility and a ``reproducibility_hash`` that is stable
across identical runs.

Attributes:
    schema_version: Schema version string, always ``"1.0"`` for this
        release.  Additive optional fields bump the minor version;
        removals / renames bump the major version.
    analysis_id: Globally unique run identifier (UUID).
    created_at: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the run started.
    status: Terminal state — ``"completed"``, ``"partial"``, or
        ``"failed"``.
    config: The ``AnalysisConfig`` that produced this result.
    dataset_fingerprint: Hash of the dataset used for reproducibility.
    split_fingerprint: Hash of the train/holdout split.
    versions: Library version strings (e.g. ``{"modelroot": "0.0.1"}``).
    rule_set_version: Version of the decision rule set applied.
    thresholds: Snapshot of the ``Thresholds`` object used.  Stored as a
        generic JSON object in M1; the ``Thresholds`` Pydantic model is
        introduced in M6.
    assessment: Assessment verdict.
    hypotheses: One result per triggered hypothesis (or sub-hypothesis).
    experiments: All experiment results produced during the analysis run.
    evidence: All evidence items cited by hypothesis results.
    warnings: Engine-level warnings (e.g. budget exceeded, partial run).
    timings: Wall-clock timings per pipeline stage.
    reproducibility_hash: Hash of config + dataset + split + thresholds +
        rule_set_version + library versions.  Same hash ⇒ identical
        verdicts (excluding timings).

Raises:
    ValueError: If ``schema_version`` is empty or ``analysis_id`` is empty.
title: AnalysisResult
